title: Dogs in space
source: Wikipedia - List of topics in space
description: Soviet-era program that sent dogs to space
executive_summary: In the 1950s and 1960s, the Soviet space program used dogs for suborbital and orbital space flights as proof-of-concept to determine whether human spaceflight was feasible. The Soviet space program typically used female dogs due to their anatomical compatibility with the spacesuit. Similarly, they used mix-breed dogs due to their apparent hardiness.
image_caption: Historical illustration of Dogs in space in outer space.
